召: name of an ancient state that existed in what is now Shaanxi Province
temple or monastery (used in place names in Inner Mongolia)
召回: to recall (a product, an ambassador etc)
召见: summon (an envoy of a foreign country) to an interview
召陵区: Shaoling, a district of Luohe City 漯河市[Luo4 he2 Shi4], Henan
姬: family name of the royal family of the Zhou Dynasty 周代[Zhou1 dai4] (1046–256 BC)
姬松茸: himematsutake mushroom (Agaricus subrufescens or Agaricus blazei Murill)
姬滨鹬: (bird species of China) least sandpiper (Calidris minutilla)
姬田鸡: (bird species of China) little crake (Zapornia parva)
姬路城: Himeji Castle in Hyogo prefecture, Japan
姬鹬: (bird species of China) jack snipe (Lymnocryptes minimus)
旬: (bound form) ten-day period; one of the three ten-day divisions of a month (e.g. 上旬[shang4 xun2])
(bound form) ten years (in age expressions, e.g. 六旬[liu4 xun2] "sixty years old")
旬始: comet from Saturn, traditionally described as yellow
旬输月送: pay every ten days, give tribute every month (idiom); incessant and ever more complicated demands
旬邑县: Xunyi, a county in Xianyang City 咸陽市/咸阳市[Xian2 yang2 Shi4], Shaanxi
旬阳市: Xunyang, a county-level city in Ankang City 安康市[An1 kang1 Shi4], Shaanxi
旬首: start of a ten day period
淬炼: (fig.) to temper; to forge; to toughen (through hardship or repeated trials)
矬子里拔将军: lit. to choose a general among the dwarves (idiom)
fig. to pick the best out of a bad group
toà tử lý bạt tương quân
诬陷: to plant false evidence against sb
韬光养晦: to conceal one's strengths and bide one's time (idiom)
to hide one's light under a bushel
韬略: originally refers to military classics Six Secret Teachings 六韜/六韬[Liu4 tao1] and Three Strategies 三略[San1 lu:e4]
